goals: Verify that the GetAllWorkshop API successfully retrieves all available workshops when no filtering criteria are specified.
Verify that the GetAllWorkshop API accurately filters and returns workshops based on provided query parameters (e.g., categories, name, description).
activities: Clean up all existing workshop data.
Create and insert workshop 1 with name 'qaRHR_name1'.
Create and insert workshop 2 with name 'qaRHR_name2'.
Construct the API URL for the 'GetAllWorkshop' endpoint.
Send a GET request to the API.
Parse the JSON response from the API.
Assert that the HTTP status code of the response is 200.
Assert that the 'Content-Type' header of the response is 'application/json'.
Assert that the 'status' field in the response body is 200.
Assert that the 'msg' field in the response body indicates success.
Assert that the data for workshop 1 is present in the response data.
Assert that the data for workshop 2 is present in the response data.
Assert that the 'detail' field is not present in the response body.
Clean up all existing workshop data.
Create and insert workshop 1 with name 'qaRHR_name1' and all categories.
Create and insert workshop 2 with name 'qaRHR_name2' and 'Fitness' category.
Construct the API URL for the 'GetAllWorkshop' endpoint, filtering by 'Cardio' category.
Send a GET request to the API with the category filter.
Parse the JSON response from the API.
Assert that the HTTP status code of the response is 200.
Assert that the 'Content-Type' header of the response is 'application/json'.
Assert that the 'status' field in the response body is 200.
Assert that the 'msg' field in the response body indicates success.
Assert that the data for workshop 1 is present in the response data.
Assert that the data for workshop 2 is NOT present in the response data.
Assert that the 'detail' field is not present in the response body.
Clean up all existing workshop data.
Create and insert workshop 1 with name 'qaRHR_name1', description 'desc1', and all categories.
Create and insert workshop 2 with name 'qaRHR_name2', description 'desc2', and 'Fitness' category.
Create and insert workshop 3 with name 'qaRHR_name3', description 'desc2', and all categories.
Create and insert workshop 4 with name 'qaRHR_name4', description 'desc1', and 'Fitness' and 'Cardio' categories.
Construct the API URL for the 'GetAllWorkshop' endpoint, filtering by name 'qaRHR', name 'name', description 'desc', and 'Strength' and 'Cardio' categories.
Send a GET request to the API with complex filters.
Parse the JSON response from the API.
Assert that the HTTP status code of the response is 200.
Assert that the 'Content-Type' header of the response is 'application/json'.
Assert that the 'status' field in the response body is 200.
Assert that the 'msg' field in the response body indicates success.
Assert that the data for workshop 1 is present in the response data.
Assert that the data for workshop 2 is NOT present in the response data.
Assert that the data for workshop 3 is present in the response data.
Assert that the data for workshop 4 is NOT present in the response data.
Assert that the 'detail' field is not present in the response body.
Perform final cleanup of all workshop data.
